what: A background scene stuck to the screen stays for one screen, and the next scene is wiped up from below during one screen of scrolling (top mask inset 100%→0, scrub 1). At 150px before the wipe is halfway, the center photo swaps with a 1.5s fade, and the side text moves up −80% and blurs out while the next text rises from below to the −50% spot

options.hold: Screens held per Section, default 1 — at 0 only the wipe continues
options.scrub: Delay after the wipe follows (sec), default 1 · true means immediate
options.swap: Where the photo and text swap — this many px before the wipe is halfway, default 150
options.phone-swap: Swap at phone width and below, original is −150
options.phone: Width treated as phone view (px), default 991
options.--fx-swap-dur: Photo and text change duration (via style), default 1.5s

use:
Text 1

Text 2

— Photos and text as many as there are scenes (optional), and give the text column (.lines) a height

from.where: index.html .tr-sticky-02 (lead scene — five backgrounds, vertical center photo, text on the right)
